profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years professional experience focused on AR/VR/XR and Simulation development using Unity, Unreal, C# and C++
profile.summary: Resourceful and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in Virtual and Augmented Reality experiences using C# and Unity.  Experienced in all phases of the software development cycle from planning and prototyping to engineering.  Thorough understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Agile development processes and procedures and strong 3D-Math and debugging skills. Demonstrated capacity for learning quickly with limited documentation, implementing new software features at a high-quality level, and providing leadership and technical guidance. Excellent communicator and leader with demonstrated integrity, resilience and ability to work with minimal to no supervision.

company.name: Mission Technologies, a division of HII

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led development to modernize maintenance and system procedures for the LHD-4 Navy ship, simulating the ship interior and training maintenance procedure steps.

- Led development for prototype navigation app for visual, auditory, and mentally impaired users utilizing features such as AR mapping utilizing the google maps API and phone camera, 3D positional audio directions using the Bose Frames and TTS.

- Assisted development for prototype VR simulator to recreate CC-TV footage  and iterate AI Agents on possible permutations based on environmental and user based conditions.

-Mentored  junior developers, helping develop technical and soft skills

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Aided in development of  a networked VR training simulator using custom Arduino-based controllers and deployed to Oculus and Magic Leap VR/AR.

- Assisted in Integration Testing for custom controllers as well as, final delivery,  demonstration and long-term support to customer.

- Assisted in development of VR/AR headset visual acuity analysis test bed with one of our chief scientists and used on Oculus, Hololens, Magic Leap and an experimental prototype headset.

- Developed Player Controller, using myoelectric bands, for game that allowed  amputees to train and  learn to use prosthetic arms.

honors.title: Advanced Achievement Award
honors.description: Recipient of the Advanced Achievement Award for the Game Development Graduating Class of October 2016. This award is voted on by students and given to one graduate per degree program who showed excellence throughout the entire degree program and is most likely to succeed after graduation.
honors.issuer: Issued by Full Sail University · Oct 2016

honors.title: Course Director Award
honors.description: Recipient of the Course Director Award for work performed during Operating Systems course. Given by Course Director to student who showed excellence in the class as well as a great attitude.
honors.issuer: Issued by Charles Graves - Operating Systems Course Director · Nov 2015
